title: The Machine public smoke benchmark
description: Small deterministic repository repairs used for CI and cross-worker comparisons.

cases.title: Repair a JavaScript arithmetic defect
cases.objective: Fix src/math.mjs so add(a, b) returns the mathematical sum. Keep the public API unchanged and do not edit the test.

cases.title: Implement a bounded text normalization rule
cases.objective: Implement normalizeGreeting in src/greeting.mjs. It must trim surrounding whitespace, collapse internal whitespace runs to one space, and return a sentence with the first character uppercased and exactly one trailing exclamation mark. Do not edit the test.
